m: व्रतिक in अ-, चान्द्र-व्र्˚ &c. (उमा-व्र्˚ w.r. for उमा-व्रतक, Hariv.)

v: pu॰ vratamasyAsti ini । 1 vrataDArake 2 yajamAne ca । amaraH ।
m: व्रतिन् mfn. observing a vow, engaged in a religious observance &c., TS.; ŚBr.; Kauś. &c.
(ifc.) engaged in, worshipping, behaving like, MBh.; BhP.
व्रतिन् m. an ascetic, devotee, MW.
one who institutes a sacrifice and employs priests (= यजमान), ib.
a: व्रतिन् — a. Observing a vow, practising penance, devout, pious; Pt. 1. 416. --m. 1 A religious student. --2 An ascetic, a devotee; Ś. 5. 9. --3 One who institutes a sacrifice; cf. यजमान.

k.v: उपाध्यायोऽध्यापकोऽथ स्यान्निषेकादिकृद्गुरुः। मन्त्रव्याख्याकृदाचार्य आदेष्टा त्वध्वरे व्रती॥
